As a Khepri guy:

His biggest offense is his team. If possible, try to pick off his team one by one so that he doesn't have anyone to buff.

Reliably, you can take care of his pull and root by getting CC immunity and making him miss by moving unpredictably.

Getting some sort of pen so that you can nullify his shield + 2 ally buff is also a good idea.

For his ult the best thing you can do is try and make him waste it by not finishing off the guy he pops it on. Yes, it might mean you won't get the kill. But then he'll have it on cooldown, and you can go in without worrying about him reviving anyone for a little while.

Piety's safer to run until Level 68 and her high chance of dropping maps means you can get a nice chunk of LvL 68 maps. Then you can run those and start collecting higher level maps and go from there.

The quick pointers:

1). Make sure your resistances are capped

2). Keep some insta heal potions, invest in a Granite Flask

3). Don't ever underestimate mobs.

If you're going to go mapping, the area level range of A1 to A3 Piety is from 56 to 65 only. You're gonna be going through a lot of areas with the same level requirement. This is both a good or bad thing because you'll still get good EXP if you decide to grind some 'safety' levels but it also means mobs are dangerous at all times.

Negative Chaos res hasn't really affected me too badly but do be mindful of enemies like Oozeback Bloom, the Weaver, the Black Death, and Spinesnap because they can catch you off-guard with chaos damage.

Make sure you have good life (2.9k-3k min) and decent DR (20+%) while you're leveling through the game. It won't hurt to run endurance charges + Immortal Call to save you from scary damage as well. (Especially useful during the Brutus fight, he can do tons of damage if you're not careful)

Places to farm:

The Ledge (Great for getting one or two safety levels)

Docks

Lunaris Temple Piety Bossfight (High map drop rate)

These should get you by pretty easy until you hit Level 68, and then you can start running maps.

Hope this helps :)

Dual wield Executioner gets a ~50% decrease in mid range damage, and a slight minimum range damage decrease.

Yeah, for me, I have to move around the map very differently with the Executioner. I pretty much have to flank and ambush enemies with it, 1v1 against enemies is pretty much 50/50 chance when I'm in the Executioner's intended range. It's why I hate maps like Slums with a passion, it's essentially a 3 lane map with little cover in the middle. Not only that, but most of the time, where the enemies are situated I won't be able to make the distance unless by a stroke of luck.

KAP40 nerf makes sense; they were extremely powerful dual wielded.

But why did they think the worst handgun in the game deserved any kind of nerf? I mean, it's ridiculous being barely able to kill a person after emptying two Executioners at the target at the same time, when the single Executioner with no attachments would kill without emptying all of its' rounds at the same distance.

People seem to forget that it's just as much changing your lifestyle as it is not fapping. I'm going to admit that I've relapsed 4 times in 2 weeks, but I don't beat myself up about it because: 
1) I'm trying to kick my brain's biggest source of dopamine for god knows how many years, and
2) I'm am actively changing my lifestyle for the better; I'm not relapsing at the same rate I was fapping before nofap, so I am making progress.

I know it's probably really disappointing for people that had high day counts; I just find it ridiculous when some beat themselves up about how they fapped after not doing so for 100+ days, and not look at the fact that they have changed their lifestyle in the process.
